trial_title: Umbilical Cord Blood Transplantation Using a Myeloablative Preparative Regimen for Hematological Diseases
brief_summary: This is a treatment guideline for an unrelated umbilical cord blood transplant (UCBT) using a myeloablative preparative regimen for the treatment of hematological diseases, including, but not limited to acute leukemias. The myeloablative preparative regimen will consist of cyclophosphamide (CY), fludarabine (FLU) and fractionated total body irradiation (TBI).

eligibility_table.criterion: Eligible Disease Status
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has Burkitt's lymphoma, not AML, and does not meet the criteria for high risk CR1.

eligibility_table.criterion: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML): high risk CR1 (as evidenced by preceding MDS, high risk cytogenetics, ≥ 2 cycles to obtain CR, erythroblastic or megakaryocytic leukemia; CR2+. All patients must be in CR as defined by hematological recovery, AND <5% blasts by light microscopy within the bone marrow with a cellularity of ≥15%.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have AML and therefore does not meet the eligibility criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Very high risk pediatric patients with AML: Patients <21 years, however, are eligible with (M2 marrow) with < 25% blasts in marrow after having failed one or more cycles of chemotherapy.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is over 21 years old and does not have AML, thus not eligible.

eligibility_table.criterion: Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia (ALL): high risk CR1 as defined by cytogenetics (such as t(9;22), t (1:19), t(4;11), other MLL rearrangements, hypodiploidy, or IKZF1 abnormalities), DNA index < 0.81, > 1 cycle to obtain CR or presence minimal residual disease (MRD). Patients in CR2+ are eligible. All patients must be in CR as defined by hematological recovery, AND <5% blasts by light microscopy within the bone marrow with a cellularity of ≥15%.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has Burkitt's lymphoma, not ALL, and does not meet the criteria for high risk CR1.

eligibility_table.criterion: Very high risk pediatric patients with ALL: patients <21 years are also considered high risk CR1 if they had M2 or M3 marrow at day 42 from the initiation of induction or M3 marrow at the end of induction. They are eligible once they achieved a complete remission.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is over 21 years old and does not have ALL, thus not eligible.

eligibility_table.criterion: Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia excluding refractory blast crisis: To be eligible in first chronic phase (CP1) patient must have failed or be intolerant to imatinib mesylate.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia and therefore does not meet the eligibility criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Plasma Cell Leukemia after initial therapy, who achieved at least a partial remission
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have Plasma Cell Leukemia and therefore does not meet the eligibility criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Advanced Myelofibrosis
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have Myelofibrosis and therefore does not meet the eligibility criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Myelodysplasia (MDS) IPSS INT-2 or High Risk (i.e. RAEB, RAEBt) or Refractory Anemia with severe pancytopenia or high risk cytogenetics: Blasts must be < 10% by a representative bone marrow aspirate morphology.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have Myelodysplasia and therefore does not meet the eligibility criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (CLL/SLL), Marginal Zone B-Cell Lymphoma or Follicular Lymphoma are eligible if there was disease progression/relapse within 12 of achieving a partial or complete remission. Patients who had remissions lasting > 12 months, are eligible after at least two prior therapies. Patients with bulky disease (nodal mass greater than 5 cm) should be considered for de-bulking chemotherapy before transplant.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has Burkitt's lymphoma, not CLL/SLL, and does not meet the criteria for eligibility.
